title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Soda Blue Wing Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Red Wing from Doozy Vape Co’s Seriously Soda collection delivers all the sublime bubbly rush of your favourite energy drink, with sweet, light fruity notes falling away to an enervating fizz on the exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices . Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
